usedFor: Botse handles chatbot conversations, and Google Drive grants file access when “New Incoming Message” runs “Share File”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Incoming Message” in Botse, then “Share File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: An incoming message can hand a specific person, or anyone, Viewer, Commenter or Editor access to a file.

watchOut: “New Message Delivered” and “New Incoming Message” are separate triggers, so “Share File” fires for the one you choose.
